A client is selling Hyperscale Center for $535,372 and wants to take $55,912 in cash while deferring the rest via 1031 exchange.

  Adjusted basis: $208,062
  Existing mortgage: $426,691
  Cash to be received: $55,912
  Replacement property: $515,441
  New mortgage: $343,548

Calculate the total boot, recognized gain, deferred gain, new basis, and tax impact of the partial exchange.
